content.text:
The drawing shows a cyclobutane ring with four vertices. One ring carbon carries both an NH2 group and a COOH group. The carbon across the ring (position 3) carries a fluorine. All bonds are plain, with no wedges or hashes, so no stereochemistry is written.

The molecule is 1-amino-3-fluorocyclobutane-1-carboxylic acid.

SMILES: NC1(C(=O)O)CC(F)C1
